Bring 1 oak boat and 6 raw cod to Oscar.
Good. I'll set her afloat. Named her too. A sailor doesn't launch a boat without a name. She's the Evening Star. Because she goes to fetch the Morning Star. (Oscar pushes the boat out and watches a long time.) When it comes up, I throw the harpoon. For the boat I never took out fifteen years ago.
부서진 해적선 곁에 저녁별을 띄웠소. 놈이 한 번 올라온 자리로 다시 올: The Evening Star is afloat beside the wrecked pirate ship. It will come back to where it rose once. The archivist says Nerakyss isn't bound to a seal, so it can't be called inside a Gate. You fight it as it is, out on the thawing sea. When its arms wrap the boat, that's your opening. Strike the arms first. It isn't angry. It thinks someone's taking a ship meant for its nest. It still has to be put to rest. The captain couldn't do it in thirty years.
부서진 해적선 곁의 바다에서 크라켄 네라키스를 잠재우세요. (최대 체력의: Put Nerakyss the kraken to rest in the waters by the wrecked pirate ship. (Deal at least 10% of its max health)

항해일지의 붙은 쪽을 떼었어요. 김을 쐬어서요. 선장이 일부러 숨긴 쪽이: I got the glued pages apart. With steam. It's the side the captain hid on purpose. Not writing. A sketch. Under the floorboards of her cabin. In the captain's cabin on the ghost ship, examine what is hidden under the floorboards.
구슬이요? 금이 간. …조사대원님, 그거 우리 기록고에 있는 것과 같은: An orb? Cracked? …That's the same as the one in our archive. The orb from my mother's things. And a drawing of the stand, you say. In purple ink. 미아가 열이 내렸어요. 그리고 그 도면을 거울로 다 읽었어요. 그 애,: Mia's fever has broken. And she read that whole drawing in a mirror. She reads mirror writing better than I do. Perhaps because she's left-handed. Hear from Isabel the archivist what Mia the apprentice read.
룬 제단이라고 부르는 그 받침대요. 우리가 1장 뒤부터 써 온 거. 그: The stand we call the Rune Altar. The one we've used since Chapter 1. Those five stones were never decoration. The drawing calls them 'five letters'. As the sea thaws, the second floor of the Spiral Abyss has opened. It was under water. The Abyss shows the memories of those who passed through. Fifteen years ago Captain Cornelia went through before she sailed. She used it as a trial to pick her crew. Please see what's left there.
부두였다고요. 선장이 선원들 앞에서 법을 읽는. 그리고 맨 뒷줄에 망토를: A dock, you say. The captain reading her law to the crew. And in the back row someone in a cloak. Not clapping. Hands behind his back. …He was there. He watched the ship leave. He saw three hundred people waving and sent them anyway.
바다가 풀렸소. 얕은 물에 고기가 돌아왔고. 열다섯 해 만에 그물을 던졌: The sea's loose. Fish are back in the shallows. I cast a net for the first time in fifteen years. My hands remembered. Come and eat. Grilled cod. Done the way Elric liked it. Salt and nothing else.
맛이 어떻소. …나는 이제 밤에 할 일을 새로 찾았소. 부두에 등을 하나: How is it. …I've found something new to do at night. I hung a lamp on the dock. Not my lantern, a dock lamp. For anyone coming in. 바다가 녹았다고. …잘했네. 정말일세. 코넬리아의 일지에 지도가 있었다지: The sea has thawed. …Well done. Truly. There was a map in Cornelia's logbook, I hear. With the places of the seven seals. Give it here. Hand the map of the seven seals to Elder Erwin.

앉게. 코넬리아의 지도를 밤새 봤네. 일곱 봉인 가운데 여섯 자리가 그려: Sit. I spent the night over Cornelia's map. Six of the seven seals are marked on it. 눈은 자네들이 갖게. 나는 보기만 하면 되네. 정말일세. 늙은이한테 그런: Keep the eyes yourselves. I only need to see them. Truly. What use would an old man have for such things? The first place is the Soul Forge in hell. 영혼 대장간은 칼데라 왕국의 지하 대장간이었네. 화로의 왕 브라간이 첫째: The Soul Forge was the underground smithy of the Caldera kingdom. Bragan, King of the Furnace, took the first eye and buried it there. 지옥의 영혼 대장간을 찾아 브람과 함께 문을 살펴보고, 불타는 망령을 4: Find the Soul Forge in hell, examine the door with Bram, and put 4 ignited revenants to rest.
밖에서 잠갔다고. 그래. 그게 브라간일세. 대장장이 백 명을 안에 두고: Barred from the outside, you say. Yes. That was Bragan. He left a hundred smiths inside and barred the door. So the way to make the giant would never get out. 대장간 큰 화로가 반쯤 죽어 있더군. 거인은 그 불로 사는데, 불이 약하: The great furnace in there is half dead. The giant lives on that fire, and with the fire weak it grows uneasy and hammers all the harder. I want to heat the expedition's blades in that furnace, once each. Only steel tempered in that fire will bite the giant's hide.
블레이즈 막대 4개와 네더라이트 조각 2개를 대장장이 브람에게 가져가세요: Bring 4 blaze rods and 2 netherite scrap to Bram the smith.
살아났네. 봤나, 불빛이 달라졌지. (브람이 조사대의 날을 하나씩 화로에: It's alive. See how the light's changed. (Bram puts the expedition's blades into the furnace one by one and draws them out.) Done. And about that hook with no name. …No, read the order first, then we'll talk.
주문서를 읽어 주게. 대장장이는 주문서를 보면 그 물건이 뭘 하려고 태어: Read me that order. A smith looks at an order and knows what the thing was born to do. Know that, then put it to rest. Berserkers circle the furnace. Fiercer than the revenants. Take care.
영혼 대장간에서 모루 밑의 주문서를 살펴보고, 불타는 광전사를 2명 잠재: Examine the order sheet under the anvil in the Soul Forge, and put 2 ignited berserkers to rest.
'이름을 주지 말 것'이라. 그래서 그놈은 이름이 없군. 이름이 없으니: 'Give it no name.' So it has none. With no name there is nothing for the fire to eat, and that's how it lasted a thousand years. And the last line. 'See that it cannot strike the door.' …But it does. With its fists. For a thousand years. Though its own body was forged not to. It's trying to let the hundred out. The hands that made it. The nameless hook is the hundredth smith's place. The one who never carved a name on anything. There's a saying in my family. 'The night the door was barred, the hundredth passed a handful of caged fire out through the gap. And stayed.' The one who took it, outside the door, was our founder.
주문서를 읽었다고. 그래, 브라간은 그런 왕이었네. 솜씨를 사랑하고 솜씨: You read the order. Yes, that was the kind of king Bragan was. He loved skill and did not trust those who had it. Open the Memory Gate. The giant must be put to rest inside. When the hammer comes down, don't hide, roll aside. And do not hate it. All it has done for a thousand years is knock on a door. Asking to be let out.
Open the Memory Gate and put the Netherite Monstrosity to rest.
놈이 쓰러지면서 마지막으로 한 번 더 문 쪽으로 팔을 뻗었다지. …잘했네: As it fell it reached for the door one last time, you say. …Well done. Truly well done. Have Isabel write the name. It has none? Then have her write that. 'The son who was given no name.' With the names of the ninety-nine, and a place for the one without. I've left the door open. Even an old man's strength was enough to draw the bar. A thousand years rots lead too.
조사대원님, 잠깐만요. 봉인 얘기가 아니에요. 대장간 이름을 적다가 수도: Wait a moment, please. This isn't about the seals. While writing down the forge's names I looked up the Order's history. Tell me if I'm seeing things.
Examine the portraits of the past Elders with Isabel the archivist.
제가 이상한 게 아니죠. 스물아홉 분이 전부 장갑을 꼈어요. 전부 왼손을: I'm not seeing things, am I. All twenty-nine wear gloves. All with the left hand laid over the right. And every painter is different. And on the back of the first Elder's portrait the painter wrote: 'Told not to paint the hands.' …It could be a family custom. Manners handed down. I'm going to think of it that way. For now. The next seal is the desert, isn't it. I'll come too. There will be a lot to read.
In Chapter 2 water rose where Sirok fell. It hasn't dried up. It's running down the thousand-year-old canal. The villagers told me. It flows only one way. Toward the king's garden. That's the second mark on the map. The Cursed Pyramid. Let's follow the water. Where it stops, that's where the king is waiting.
사막의 저주받은 피라미드를 찾아 이사벨과 함께 마른 수반을 살펴보고, 코: Find the Cursed Pyramid in the desert, examine the dry basin with Isabel, and put 8 koboletons to rest.
물은 문 앞에서 멈췄어요. 한 뼘 앞에서요. 수반은 말라 있고요. 시로크: The water stopped at the door. A hand's width short. And the basin is dry. That's the last stretch Sirok never dug. And the koboletons. There were water-yoke marks on their bones. They were gardeners. They followed the king in and never came out. There's writing on the door. A lot of it. Please fetch water. I want the basin filled while I read. That was the promise. 'The day the water arrives.'
문 글씨를 다 읽었어요. 왕의 글이에요. 정원 안에서 문에 대고 쓴 거예: I've read the whole door. It's the king's writing. Written from inside the garden, on the door. For someone outside to read. Did you bring the water? Fill the basin while you listen. We'll bridge the last hand's width. In Sirok's place.
물 양동이 3개를 기록관 이사벨에게 가져가 수반을 채우고, 왕의 글을 들: Bring 3 water buckets to Isabel the archivist, fill the basin, and hear the king's words.
수반이 찼어요. 문 안에서 뭐가 일어났어요. 아주 큰 게요. 뼈 부딪는: The basin's full. Something stirred behind the door. Something very large. I heard bone on bone. It's the gatekeeper. The beast the king rode. He knew the price of the eye was a kingdom buried. So he walked into the garden himself and had the door shut, so the sand would swallow the garden before the villages. He saved his people. But he never told his two beasts. That he wasn't coming back. He only said 'wait'. That's what the king handed off. The telling of the truth.
조사대원님… 저 갇혔어요. 문지기가 일어나니까 피라미드 안쪽 길이 다 바: I… I'm trapped. When the gatekeeper rose, every passage inside the pyramid shifted. Sand came pouring down. Where I am looks like an arena. It's where they tested who could enter the garden. It says so on the wall. And one gladiator is still standing. It's looking at me. I think it's asking whether I'm worthy. All I have is a pen.
Put the Kobolediator in the Cursed Pyramid to rest and rescue Isabel the archivist.
(Isabel brushes off the sand and laughs. Her hands are shaking.) Thank you. That gladiator. It knelt before it fell. Not the way the loser kneels. The way the one who lets you pass kneels. It means we were worthy. The first to pass in a thousand years. There was a space on the wall for the names of those who passed. It was empty. I wrote one in. The expedition.
…사막의 왕은 내 스승의 벗이었네. 아니. 그렇게 읽었네. 책에서. 문지: …The King of the Desert was a friend of my teacher's. No. So I've read. In books. The gatekeeper is the beast the king rode. They call it the Ancient Remnant. Nothing left but bone, and still it kept the door. Open the Memory Gate. Keep clear of where the sand heaves. It hides underground.
Open the Memory Gate and put the Ancient Remnant to rest.
(장로는 한참 말이 없다.) 짐승이 쓰러지며 고개를 숙였다지. 누구에게: (The Elder says nothing for a long time.) The beast bowed its head as it fell, you say. As if greeting someone. The door opened and the king was sitting inside the garden. By the dry fountain. Facing the door. In his bones. …So he waited too. Knowing it wouldn't open. That was not in the books. Have Isabel write it down. I… am going to walk a while. Alone.
나선의 심연 3층이 열렸어요. 수도회 옛 기록에 3층은 '회의'라고만 적: The third floor of the Spiral Abyss has opened. The Order's old records call it only 'the council'. The council a thousand years ago where they agreed to divide the Flame. The Chronicle says seven kings sat. The page we found in Chapter 1 said 'the eighth seat is empty; the seven emptied it'. Please see for yourself. How many seats there are.
여덟이었군요. 그리고 여덟째 왕이 반대했다고요. '나눈 불은 언젠가 누군: Eight, then. And the eighth king objected. 'A fire divided will one day be gathered again.' And the youngest king, shaking, said what? 'Feed it a prisoner's name.' …What does feeding a name mean? Dividing the Flame needed a name? And beside the eighth king stood a young apprentice in a grey cloak. And the memory broke off there. As if someone cut it. It's what my mother's echo said. 'When all are gathered, someone will use it.'
셋째 자리는 톱니의 여왕 오르델의 도시일세. 지금은 공장만 남았지. 여왕: The third place is the city of Ordel, Queen of Cogs. Only the factory remains. The queen built a machine to reckon what was to come. And when she saw its answer she stopped every clock in the city. Go and see why. This time I'll come inside. I must see with my own eyes what that machine reckoned.
고대 공장을 찾아 에르윈과 함께 큰 시계를 살펴보고, 감시자를 8기 멈추: Find the Ancient Factory, examine the great clock with Erwin, and stop 8 watchers.
열두 시 한 분 전이라. 온 도시의 시계가. 여왕은 기계한테 물었지. ': One minute to twelve. Every clock in the city. The queen asked the machine, 'When is the end?' The machine answered, and she stopped the clocks so that hour would never come. If the clocks don't run, the end doesn't arrive. A child's idea. …I know that feeling. The watchers are clock-keepers. They watch for anyone who winds a spring. What comes when one is wound, you'll soon learn.
기계가 잠들어 있네. 도시의 시각이 멈춰서 기계도 멈춘 걸세. 깨우려면: The machine is asleep. The city's hour stopped, so the machine stopped. To wake it the great clock has to run again. Bring a clock and redstone. I'll do the winding. When it's wound, the hunter will come. The Prowler. A machine that seeks whoever winds a spring. It will chase me. You strike it from behind while it does. …An old man playing bait. What next.
시계 1개와 레드스톤 가루 8개를 가져오고, 고대 공장의 프라울러를 멈추: Bring 1 clock and 8 redstone dust, and stop the Prowler in the Ancient Factory.
(장로가 숨을 고른다. 웃는다.) 이 나이에 뛸 줄이야. 로란이 봤으면: (The Elder catches his breath. He laughs.) Running, at my age. Roran would have teased me. The clock is going. Do you hear it? One minute has passed, for the first time in a thousand years. It's twelve. The machine has opened its eye. It has begun spitting paper. Everything it reckoned. A thousand years' worth at once. Your names are in it.
하빈저일세. 끝을 보라고 만든 기계. 여왕은 제가 물은 것의 답을 감당하: The Harbinger. A machine built to see the end. The queen couldn't bear the answer to her own question, so she handed it to the machine. 'You saw it, so you guard it.' Open the Memory Gate. Whatever reckoning it recites as it falls, let it pass. A machine only says what it saw. It doesn't know what it means.
Open the Memory Gate and put the Harbinger to rest.
\"마지막 문을 여는 것은 불씨를 쥔 자들이다. 그 손을 이끄는 것은 장: 'Those who open the last door are the ones who hold the embers. The hand that guides them wears a glove.' That's what the machine recited. (The Elder strikes the floor with his staff. A face you have never seen on him.) What does a lump of iron know! A sum done a thousand years ago! People do not go the way they're reckoned. They do not. …Forgive me. I shouted. Patience wears thin with age. Give the printout to Isabel. The road you've walked is written on it. It reckoned even that.

기계가 '장갑'이라고 했다지. 기록관이 인쇄지를 들고 왔더라. 그리고 카: The machine said 'glove', I hear. The archivist brought me the printout. And Kael's letter. The one she tucked into the Chronicle in Chapter 2. 증거 없이 따지면 장로는 웃고 만다. 그리고 다음부터는 더 조심한다. 스: Go at him without proof and the Elder smiles and that's the end of it. And from then on he's more careful. I learned that twenty years ago. Hammer on a door in a hurry and all you do is ready whoever's behind it. Four seals left. Walk beside him to the end. Watch as you walk. A man who walks long enough starts to limp. On the side he's hiding. I can't go, with this leg. So I'm asking you. Be my eyes.
미아가요, 룬 제단을 닦다가 받침대 밑판이 헐거운 걸 찾았어요. 3장에서: Mia was polishing the Rune Altar and found the base plate of the stand is loose. Going by the drawing from Chapter 3, the plate was always meant to open. There's writing inside, she says. Mirror writing. She read it and won't tell me. 'Look for yourself, teacher.' Please look with me. And while you're at the altar, watch who comes by.
Examine the inside of the Rune Altar's stand.
\"이 글자들을 그 아이에게 보이지 마라.\" …그 아이가 누구예요. 다: 'Do not show these letters to that child.' …Who is 'that child'? We learned in Chapter 3 that the five stones are letters. Who are they hidden from? You saw the Elder pass just now. He stopped at the altar. He looked at the five stones a long time. Then he said, 'I feel I've seen this hand somewhere.' And walked on. He can't read them. Right in front of him. Mia cried when she saw it. She says she doesn't know why.
넷째 자리는 바다 밑이라지. 내가 가겠소. 바다가 녹은 뒤로 밤마다 밑에: The fourth place is under the sea, they say. I'll go. Since the thaw, singing comes up from below every night. Not that bait-voice from Chapter 3. People singing. Many. Without rest. But these last days they drop out one by one. Fewer voices. Let's go see. The Elder says he'll stay ashore. He won't board a boat.
가라앉은 도시를 찾아 오스카와 함께 노래의 석판을 살펴보고, 딥링을 8명: Find the Sunken City, examine the slab of the song with Oscar, and defeat 8 deeplings.
자장가였군. 천 년째 부르는. 여왕이 사제들한테 그랬다는 거요. '멈추지: A lullaby. Sung for a thousand years. The queen told the priests, 'Don't stop. If you stop, it wakes.' No relief. When a priest fell, the child took it up. That's what the queen handed off. The lullaby she should have sung herself. …But why fewer voices? Something lay under the slab. A grey coin. Off a priest's neck. Someone paid the priests. To stop singing.
노래를 끊는 자들: Those Who Would Cut the Song
남은 사제가 둘이오. 둘이서 밤낮으로 부르오. 목이 다 쉬었지. 그런데: Two priests left. Two of them singing day and night. Their voices are worn to nothing. And big brutes and spell-casters stand round them. Not guarding. Trying to stop their mouths. Those ones wear the coins too. Clear them off. Don't touch the priests. Those two are the last line of a thousand years of lullaby.
Defeat 2 deepling brutes and 2 deepling warlocks in the Sunken City.
늦었소. 놈들은 치웠는데, 사제 하나가 그 틈에 쓰러졌소. 지쳐서. 하나: Too late. We cleared them, but one priest dropped in the gap. Worn out. The last one sings alone and hasn't the breath. There are breaks between the bars. Below, something big rolled over. It's waking. Before its time. …The last priest pressed something into my hand. An eye. The Eye of the Abyss. It means: we can't sing any more, put it to rest. In place of the lullaby.
리바이어던이오. 여왕이 기르던 짐승이라더이다. 봉인이 생기기 전엔 바다: The Leviathan. A beast the queen raised, they say. The slab said that before the seal the children of the city under the sea rode on its back. The queen buried the eye inside it, and since the city would fall if it woke, she put it to sleep. A thousand years. Open the Memory Gate. Out of water it has no strength. Draw it to the shallows. I'll be at the door singing that song. I've got the eight bars by heart.
Open the Memory Gate and put the Leviathan to rest.
놈이 눈을 감았소. 자는 눈이 아니라 쉬는 눈으로. 마지막 사제가 노래를: It closed its eyes. Not sleeping eyes. Resting ones. The last priest stopped singing. First time in a thousand years. Know the first thing that priest said in a speaking voice? 'It's quiet.' (Oscar takes off his cap.) I went to tell the Elder and he wasn't on the shore. He was over the hill. Where you can't see the sea. With his back turned. I said, 'The sea's gone quiet.' He said, 'Has it. I didn't see.' Wouldn't see, not couldn't.
다섯째 자리는 허공일세. 1장에서 용을 재운 그 땅. 거기 무너진 성채가: The fifth place is the void. The land where you put the dragon to rest in Chapter 1. There's a fallen citadel there. Where the eight kings held council. The void's mist hides it from the naked eye. Grind a lens from the shell of the great crab that lives in the amethyst nest underground and you can see through the mist. …I found that method when I was young. In a book. Yes, in a book.
Find the amethyst nest underground and defeat the amethyst crab.
잘 깎였네. (장로가 렌즈를 눈에 댄다. 오래 본다. 렌즈를 내린 손이: It's cut well. (The Elder holds the lens to his eye. He looks a long time. The hand that lowers it is shaking.) I see it. The room that held eight thrones. You saw it in the Abyss, you said. The council. How far did you see? As far as the eighth standing up. …And nothing after. Yes. What came after, I too… it isn't in the books. Come. I'll go inside this time as well. This place I must go to.
성채일세. 왕좌를 하나씩 보게. 왕들은 회의가 끝나고 제 자리에 하나씩: The citadel. Look at the thrones one by one. They say that when the council ended each king left something on his seat. To use when they met again. They never met again. Endermaptera will have gathered. Clear them as you go.
엔드의 폐허 성채를 찾아 에르윈과 함께 일곱 왕좌를 살펴보고, 엔더맙테라: Find the Ruined Citadel in the End, examine the seven thrones with Erwin, and defeat 8 endermaptera.
일곱 자리에 일곱 가지가 남았군. 망치, 물동이, 태엽 열쇠, 조가비,: Seven things on seven seats. A hammer, a water jar, a winding key, a shell, a shard of ice, a lump of sealing wax, and an empty scabbard. That one is Caldern's. A scabbard and no sword. He gave the sword to his knight-commander. Along with the fire. Each of them left something. What remained after they'd handed off everything they could. The eighth seat is at the very back. Come. …No, wait. Let me get my breath.
조사대원님, 저도 왔어요. 로란 대장님이 혼자 두지 말랬다면서요. 저는: I've come too. Captain Roran told you not to leave me alone, didn't he. I came so the Elder wouldn't be alone. Strange, isn't it. There's a golem standing before the eighth seat. Built of void stone. It isn't guarding a door. It's guarding the seat. So no one sits there. Put the golem to rest and let's look at the seat together. The Elder is back there. He can't come any closer.
Put the Ender Golem in the Ruined Citadel to rest, and examine the eighth throne.
장로님이 그 자리 앞에서 무릎이 꺾였어요. 제가 부축했어요. 팔이… 뜨거: The Elder's knees gave way in front of that seat. I held him up. His arm… was hot. Even through the glove. And he said, 'Don't read it. You won't be able to. Neither can I.' The scratched-out name. It was eight letters long. You can count them. The shapes are gone. But listen. The scrap of cloth on the back of the seat. It's grey. The hem of a cloak. A thousand years old and not rotted. No one was trying to sit here. Someone was hanging on here. Holding on to a person being dragged away.
…You saw me at my worst. Old knees. Nothing more. Put the Ender Guardian to rest. The keeper Velas set before his lock. To stop anyone who asks. Open the Memory Gate. The grey cloth? Old cloth. Nothing rots in the void. Nothing more than that. Hurry.
Open the Memory Gate and put the Ender Guardian to rest.
가디언이 무너지며 여덟째 자리를 가리켰다지. 묻지 말라고 세운 것이 마지: As the Guardian fell it pointed at the eighth seat, you say. The thing set there to forbid asking pointed, at the last. (The Elder is silent a long while before he speaks.) One left. The Frost Prison. That place… I cannot go. Not even to the door. Don't ask why. Ask when you return. I will answer then. I promise.
마지막 자리예요. 서리 감옥. 장로님은 정말 안 오셨어요. 수도회 문 앞: The last place. The Frost Prison. The Elder truly didn't come. He only raised a hand at the Order's door. This king is unlike the others. The Chronicle says 'the King of Frost entrusted his eye to no one'. I took that as praise, but after seeing that small seat among the seven thrones I'm not sure. The seat with 'I'm afraid' scratched into it. Let's look at the prison first. At who locked up whom.
얼어붙은 감옥을 찾아 감방을 살펴보고, 드라우그 8명과 정예 드라우그 2: Find the Frosted Prison, examine the cell, and put 8 draugr and 2 elite draugr to rest.
감방 문이 전부 안에서 잠겨 있었어요. 열쇠는 감방 안에 있고요. 간수가: Every cell door was locked from the inside. The keys are inside the cells. It's a prison with no jailers. The prisoner walked in and locked himself up. The draugr are the king's soldiers. He went in, so they followed. The king's writing was on the wall. An eighteen-year-old's hand. He keeps getting his spelling wrong. He wrote down, himself, what he said at the council.
왕의 묘실 앞에 근위대가 있어요. 왕관을 쓴 드라우그와, 문짝만 한 앞트: The king's guard stands before his tomb chamber. A draugr wearing a crown, and an aptrgangr the size of a door. The crowned one is the king's brother. It was on the wall. 'My brother said he didn't want to be king. So I became king. He was sorry, and followed me in.' And listen. I'm done pretending not to know. The glove on the printout. The grey cloth. The portraits. My mother's last page. When we meet the king I'm going to ask. Who the grey cloak is. Someone who has lived a thousand years will know.
Put the Royal Draugr and the Aptrgangr in the Frosted Prison to rest.
근위대가 쓰러졌어요. 왕관이 굴러서 묘실 문 앞에 멈췄어요. 문 틈으로: The guard has fallen. The crown rolled and stopped at the chamber door. A voice is coming through the gap. It's young. About our Mia's age. It's calling, 'Brother?' …There's no one left to answer. We put him to rest. Please go and take what he says. I'll write it down. Don't open the door yet. He hasn't spoken with anyone before a fight in a thousand years.
Please stand at the gap in the chamber door. The king will speak. Listen, and answer him. I'll write every word. And if the king asks you something… answer however you wish. There won't be a right answer.
Hear the king through the gap in the tomb chamber door of the Frost Prison, and answer him.
(이사벨의 펜이 멈춰 있다.) 다 적었어요. '회색 망토는 한 달 전에도: (Isabel's pen has stopped.) I have all of it. 'The grey cloak came a month ago too. In a thousand years he has come a hundred times. Each time his face was a little different. The glove was the same.' And the promise. 'A life without end.' The king was to take that and open the door. Give up the eye. But after your answer he was quiet a long time. Then he said, 'Then put me to rest. The promise was made with that man. You owe it nothing.' …The door opened from inside.
왕이 문을 열었어요. 스스로요. 기억의 문을 열어 주세요. 봉인이 터지지: The king opened the door. Himself. Please open the Memory Gate. He must be put to rest inside so the seal doesn't burst. He flies through the air throwing spears and reaps the souls of the fallen. He'll fight as a fight is fought. A thousand years of habit. But he asked to be put to rest. Please don't forget that.
Open the Memory Gate and put Maledictus, King of Frost, to rest.
왕이 쓰러지며 한 말이요. '회색 망토의 학자에게 전해라. 나는 약속을: What the king said as he fell. 'Tell the scholar in the grey cloak. I take back the promise. And that one did not blame you. I was there. I saw.' …I wrote it down. The king's name too. Maledictus. Eighteen years old. Someone was standing at the prison entrance. The one who said he couldn't come. Holding the door frame. Smoke was rising from his glove. He heard all of it. Then he turned and left. Toward the Order. Let's go. Now.
There's a light in the Elder's room. Let's go. I've brought everything I mean to ask about. The hands in the portraits. The hidden line in Kael's letter. The note from the captain's wallet. The machine's printout. The scrap of grey cloth. And my mother's last page. I'll lay them out. Please just stand beside me. He promised to answer when we came back and asked. The Elder doesn't break promises. That's what frightens me most.
Go to Elder Erwin with Isabel the archivist.
(The Elder takes off his glove. Slowly. One finger at a time. There is fire on the back of his right hand. Not burning. Carved. In the shape of a flame. No. Look again and there are strokes.) "I told you to keep the eyes. They are husks. Six have closed, and that is enough. The rest is at the bottom of hell. I have waited a thousand years. Your expedition… you were good people. That was the hardest part." The Elder put his hand into the archive lantern. The fire passed into his hand. And he was gone.
…The archive lantern has gone out. My mother's lantern. The one we lit together in Chapter 1. The Elder took it. I'm all right. Really. Only sit here with me a little while. You don't have to say anything.
장로님 책상에 제 습자 공책이 있었어요. 일곱 살 때 거요. 장로님이 빨: My copybook was on the Elder's desk. From when I was seven. The one he corrected in red ink. He never threw it away. On the last page there was one line in his hand. 'This child will read to the end, like her mother. What do I do with her then?' …There was no answer written. I'm going to read to the end. And this time I'm going to write to the end. Captain Roran is gathering the expedition. They're going to the bottom of hell.
장로님 방이에요. 문은 열려 있었어요. 잠근 적이 없는 방이에요. 저는: This is the Elder's room. The door was open. It has never been locked. I learned my letters here. But I have never once opened a drawer. Please open them with me. I said I'd read to the end.
Examine what is left in Erwin's room with Isabel the archivist.
문은 장로님이 지은 거였어요. 기억의 문이요. 서장에서 장로님이 직접 가: The Gate was the Elder's own work. The Memory Gate. The first rule he taught us himself in the prologue. 'A guardian is put to rest only inside a Gate.' So the seals wouldn't burst, he said. That was true. But there was a second truth. The share of whatever is put to rest inside does not scatter. It runs to one place. To the brand. …We did that. Six times. With our own hands. But listen. In the corner of the drawing the Elder wrote down one worry. When I read that line I breathed for the first time.
이름을 적는 게 그냥 버릇인 줄 알았어요. 잠든 것들한테 미안해서 적은: I thought writing the names was only a habit. I wrote them because I felt sorry for the ones we put to rest. It was holding something, it turns out. Then I must write more. First I'll light the lantern again. Half a jar of my mother's ink is left. It was the Elder who told me that ash is the ash of the Dusk Flame. Funny, isn't it. Bring me just one blaze rod. Like in Chapter 1.
Bring 1 blaze rod to Isabel the archivist.
(등불이 켜진다. 전보다 작다. 그래도 켜졌다.) 됐어요. 이 불 밑에서: (The lantern lights. Smaller than before. But lit.) There. Under this light I read back every name I've written. The three captains of the Black Star. Horus. Helvar. Cornelia and the three hundred and thirty-two. The son who was given no name. The gatekeeper. Maledictus. Not one line has faded. The world has half forgotten them already, and here they're sharp. If this is what worried the Elder, this is our blade. Please go to Captain Roran. I'll write one more line and follow.
기록관한테 들었다. 문이 그 양반 거였다고. 그래서 스무 해 전에 나한테: The archivist told me. The Gate was his. So that's why he never taught it to me twenty years ago. Back then he was still counting how the shares burst and scattered. With eleven people. …I'll be angry later. He's gone to the Burning Arena. The bottom of hell, the seventh seal. Where the wick sleeps. I'm gathering the expedition. This time I go too. Even into land I don't know.
오스카, 브람, 펠릭스, 하루, 모리스. 다 왔다. 인원 확인은 돌아와서: Oscar, Bram, Felix, Haru, Morris. All here. I'll count heads when we're back. And get it right. …But the archivist is missing. The girl who said she'd write one more line and come. The lantern's lit in the archive and the pen is gone. The ink jar too. He took her. Or she followed on her own feet. She is that kind of girl.
지옥이다. 펠릭스가 그러더라. 열다섯 해 전 엘레나는 가는 데마다 잉크: Hell. Felix told me. Fifteen years ago Elena left an ink dot everywhere she went. For whoever came after. You followed them in Chapter 1. Look. There on the basalt. A dot. Still wet. The girl made it. While being led away. This time the daughter marks and we follow. Stay behind me. Never mind the leg.
지옥에서 로란과 함께 이사벨이 남긴 잉크 점을 따라가고, 길을 막는 불타: Follow the ink dots Isabel left through hell with Roran, and put to rest 6 ignited revenants blocking the way.
점이 경기장 문 앞에서 끝났다. 마지막 점 옆에 글씨가 있다. 급하게 쓴: The dots end at the arena door. There's writing beside the last one. Hurried. 'I'm all right. I won't write it. Except one name.' …Except one name. She knows what has to be written. Did you pick up the ash the revenants dropped? They say it makes a sound in your fist. That's memory the fire spilled while eating. Listen and you'll know whose.
Give me that ash. The archivist's gone, so I'll do the listening. A fisherman has good ears. I listened under the ice for fifteen years. Makes a sound when you hold it, you said. I'll hold all three at once.
Hand the 3 memory shards to Oscar the fisherman.
(오스카가 조각을 쥐고 오래 눈을 감았다.) 아이요. 고아였소. 궁정 필: (Oscar holds the shards with his eyes shut a long time.) A boy. An orphan. Taken into a court scriptorium. Had no name till the king gave him one. Erwin. That king taught him his letters too. The next shard is loud. The day of the council. Someone dragged the boy out of the room. On the king's order. 'See that this child does not watch.' He clung to the arm of the throne and wouldn't let go, and his cloak tore. The last shard. When he broke the door and got back in, his teacher was already in the fire. The seven stood round it. The boy put his hand in. To pull him out. …That's all the man ever saw. Seven standing round, and his teacher burning.
꺼지지 않는 문: The Door That Won't Go Out
불꽃 경기장이다. 문 앞 결계는 최초의 불꽃 그 자체다. 물로는 안 꺼진: The Burning Arena. The ward on its door is the First Flame itself. Water won't put it out. That crystal Frostmaw was holding in Chapter 2. The one the Elder said never to sell. He already meant it for this door. We use the key he had us make ready with his own hands. Hand me the crystal. I'll set it. Three of mine fell guarding that. The captain sets it.
결정이 녹으며 불길이 갈라졌다. 안이 보인다. 왕좌 앞에 기록관이 서 있: The crystal melted and the flames parted. You can see inside. The archivist is standing before the throne. Not bound. Her pen hand pressed to her chest. He's on his knees in front of her. Begging. Her. 'Write one line for me. The name the fire will give back. Even your mother couldn't.' She shakes her head. He stands and puts his hand into the fire. Something in armour rises out of it. The knight from the dreams.
손바닥에 적은 이름: A Name Written on a Palm
(불길 너머에서 이사벨이 소리친다.) 조사대원님! 들려요? 저는 괜찮아요: (Isabel shouts from beyond the flames.) Can you hear me? I'm all right! The Elder can't hurt me. He needs my hand! But he took my paper. I have ink and nowhere to write. Arden's name has to be written before he's put to rest. Anywhere! Revenants are in the way. Berserkers. Please clear them. Just while I write!
Put to rest the 3 ignited berserkers surrounding Isabel in the Burning Arena.
(이사벨이 왼손을 들어 보인다. 손바닥에 잉크로 세 글자가 적혀 있다.): (Isabel holds up her left hand. A name is written on the palm in ink.) I wrote it. Here. I had no paper. 'Arden.' The Elder saw. He saw and said nothing. He could have cut off my hand and he didn't. He only… smiled. A little. 'Just like your mother,' he said. Now put him to rest. Inside the Gate. The share won't go to the Elder. It'll stay on my palm. It will be a little hot, they say. I don't mind.
아르덴이다. 지금은 이그니스라고 부른다. 천 년 동안 불을 제 몸에 가둔: Arden. They call him Ignis now. A man who held the fire inside his own body for a thousand years. He kept saying it in the dreams. Don't come, the fire is rising past me. It has. That thing is half Arden and half fire. He splits the ground with a sword of flame, guards with his shield, and at the last wraps himself in blue fire. The whole expedition goes. Open the Memory Gate. His Gate, and this time we use it our way.
Open the Memory Gate and put Ignis to rest.
기사가 쓰러졌다. 눈에서 불이 꺼지고 사람의 눈이 돌아왔다. 몫은 문지방: The knight fell. The fire left his eyes and a man's eyes came back. The share ran over the threshold, and bent away in front of that man's hand. It went to the archivist's palm. And six strands came out of his brand after it. Without the wick they can't stay pooled. The six strands ran toward the archive. To the written names. Back where they belong. He sat down in the ash. The back of his hand went cold. For the first time in a thousand years. Arden looked at him and spoke. I heard it clearly. Go and hear it from the archivist. She took it down.
그 문을 지킨 사람: The One Who Kept That Door
아르덴 님이 잠들기 전에 한 말이에요. 장로님한테 한 말이요. 저는 손이: What Arden said before he slept. He said it to the Elder. My hand shook and I got it wrong twice. But I have all of it. Please read it with me. The Elder is sitting over there. In the ash. He hasn't said a word yet.
Read Arden's words, taken down by Isabel the archivist, together.
스스로 걸어 들어가신 거였어요. 여덟째 왕은요. 쫓겨난 게 아니라. 일곱: He walked in himself. The eighth king. He wasn't driven out. The seven didn't feed him to it. When someone said to use a prisoner's name he stood and said, 'A world kept with someone else's name has not been kept.' And he sent his apprentice out of the room. Because that boy would follow him in if he saw. The Elder never knew. For a thousand years. Hating the seven. …The Elder just spoke for the first time. 'Then who was I angry at?' I don't think he was asking me.
(재 위에 노인이 앉아 있다. 장갑이 없다. 손등의 획은 식어서 흉터가: (An old man sits in the ash. No glove. The stroke on his hand has cooled into a scar. He looks far older. He looks his age.) …Sit. I haven't the strength to stand. Take out what's inside my coat. My hands can't hold paper now. It's the original of the oath. What Elena was looking for. With the third line.
Take the original oath from inside Erwin's coat and read it together.
그분의 글씨일세. 불에 들어가시기 전날 밤에 내 필통에 넣어 두신 쪽지지: It is his hand. A note he slipped into my pen case the night before he went into the fire. Three lines. 'Keep the Flame. Keep the seals. And when the time comes, let me go.' I built the Order on the first two. The third I erased. For a thousand years I read that line as 'let the world drop him'. Words the seven made him write. Forced. …If he went of his own will, then that line was a request. Made to me. For a thousand years I disobeyed the last thing my teacher asked of his apprentice.
이그니스가 쓰러진 자리에 남은 회색 재요. 그건 불의 재가 아니에요. 장: The grey ash left where Ignis fell. That isn't the fire's ash. It fell from the Elder's brand. A thousand years of it. The ink of ash is made from ash. Mix ink from that and you can write one line. Exactly one. Whether to write the name 'Erwin' in the Chronicle or not, that's the line. I can't decide. I learned my letters from his hand, and I lost my mother because of him. Please decide for me. Either way I will write it as you say.
Hand the thousand-year-old ash to Isabel the archivist, and decide the one line.
썼어요. 정해 주신 대로요. 잉크가 마르는 동안 장로님이 옆에서 보고 계: It's written. As you decided. While the ink dried the Elder stood beside me watching. He said nothing. When it was dry he said one thing. 'Good strokes.' …That's all. He has gone down to the Order's cellar. To the room where Kas was. On his own. The door isn't locked. Captain Roran's orders. 'Come out if you want. But each time you do, say the eleven names first.'
Please come to the dock. The one where you first landed in the prologue. Everyone is there. I want to write the last page of the Chronicle there. Not in the archive. My mother was the one who read to the end. I'll be the one who writes to the end. Before I write, say a word to each of them. That's what an expedition does, I'm told.
부두에서 어부 오스카, 탐험대장 로란과 인사하고, 기록관 이사벨과 마지막: At the dock, speak with Oscar the fisherman and Captain Roran, and write the last page with Isabel the archivist.
\"불을 지키고, 봉인을 지키고, 그리고 때가 되어 놓아주었다.\" 마지: "We kept the Flame, we kept the seals, and when the time came we let go." The last page. I wrote it in the name of every member of the expedition, one by one. Everyone who came on the seventeen ships. Yours too. In the ink of ash. Fire can't eat it. The First Flame is still there. Every seven days it will burn again in Arden's shape. Each time, put it to rest inside the Gate. The share goes to no one now. It goes to the name. That is what keeping meant. From the beginning.
조사대원님, 미아가 할 말이 있대요. 그날 불 속에서 구해 준 그 아이요: Mia has something to tell you. The girl you carried out of the fire that day. Hearing that you saw the council of eight kings in the Abyss reminded her of something. She says she can't tell me. She will if you're here.
보랏빛으로 고친 자국이라니. 누가 연대기를 고쳐 썼다는 거예요. 불에 탄: Corrections in purple. Someone rewrote the Chronicle. The shelves burned, but it stayed in Mia's eyes. And Mia says the corrected hand 'wasn't in a hurry'. Not altered like a theft. Altered like something cherished. Stroke by stroke. That's stranger still.
항해일지 사이의 도면이요. 보랏빛 잉크였죠. 1장 마녀의 단지 밑바닥에: The drawing between the logbook's pages. Purple ink, wasn't it. The colour at the bottom of the witch's jar in Chapter 1. The evokers of the Ashen Band carry that ink. They don't know themselves who gives it to them. 'Leave the bottle before a mirror and it's full.' Evokers only come out when they raid a village. If you meet one while holding off a raid, bring me a bottle.
잉크병이에요. 바닥에 거울 문양이 있어요. 그리고 병 안쪽에 아주 작은: An ink bottle. With a mirror mark on the base. And tiny writing on the inside. Reversed. 'Bring the pages and I will fill it. Before that child does.' …Before that child. Two bounties were posted in Chapter 1. The grey coin with two different faces. One was the Elder's, one was this person's. For the same pages, each trying to reach them first.
안개가 걷힌 저택: The Mansion Out of the Mist
마지막 장을 쓰고 나서요. 빈 줄 하나 남겨 뒀다고 했죠. 그 줄을 채울: After I wrote the last page. I told you I left one line empty. If anyone can fill it, it's the owner of the purple ink. The mansion in the dark forest. The Ashen Band's ancestral house. Wrapped in purple mist for a thousand years so no one could enter. But the mist has lifted since yesterday. Since the day the Elder's brand went cold. Let's go together. This time I'll follow you. There will be things to read.
Find the woodland mansion in the dark forest and examine the mirror room underground with Isabel.
Eight mirrors. Five of them showed the five stones of the Rune Altar. Attack, defence, evasion… the five letters with those silly names laid over them. The sixth showed the back of a hand. The seventh a single dot. The eighth was dark and only hummed. Eight letters. It's a name. This person held up a mirror at the moment the name burned and saved five letters. And for a thousand years had us touch them every day. As a gacha. …Not hidden. Entrusted.
천 번 고쳐 쓴 한 줄: One Line Rewritten a Thousand Times
거울 뒷면에 문이 있었어요. 필경실이에요. 책상 하나, 의자 하나, 그리: There was a door behind the mirrors. A scriptorium. One desk, one chair, and paper. The room is full of paper. All the same page. One page of the Chronicle rewritten a thousand times. There are doorkeepers. The Ashen Band's axemen. They're guarding the master. We have to clear them to read. Please don't hate them. To them the master of this house is the only elder who ever promised to find their lineage.
숲속 저택에서 필경실의 초고를 살펴보고, 문지기 변명자를 6명 물리치세요: Examine the drafts in the scriptorium of the woodland mansion, and defeat 6 vindicator doorkeepers.
천 번이에요. 같은 한 줄을요. '일곱이 여덟째를 일으켜 세웠다.' 처음: A thousand times. The same single line. 'The seven raised the eighth to his feet.' In the first hundred sheets the hand shakes. The strokes waver. The handwriting of someone writing a lie for the first time. Further on it steadies. He got used to it. And the note in the desk drawer. 'That child must not know. If he learns the teacher went of his own will he will read it as being abandoned. Give him something to hate. Hate keeps a person alive.' …He means the Elder. This person rewrote the Chronicle to keep the Elder alive.
거울 속 사람이 우리를 막아요. 벨로크래요. 초고 귀퉁이마다 서명이 있었: The one in the mirror is barring our way. Velok. The signature was in the corner of every draft. Court scribe to the eighth king. The Elder's senior. He means to fight because he fears we'll take the original to the Elder. He doesn't know the Elder already knows. News from outside doesn't seem to reach inside a mirror. He won't believe us. Being inside a mirror, he can only be reached through a Memory Gate. Please put him to rest. And tell him as you do. That the child bore it.
Open the Memory Gate and put Velok, the scribe in the mirror, to rest.
거울이 전부 깨졌어요. 여덟 장이 한꺼번에요. 깨지면서 벨로크가 물었대요: Every mirror broke. All eight at once. As they broke Velok asked, 'The child knows? Knows and is still standing?' And after a long while: 'Then for a thousand years I underrated him.' One sheet was left among the shards. Not purple. Black ink. The original, unaltered. Just one. He rewrote a thousand sheets and never could alter that one.
고치지 못한 한 장: The One Page He Couldn't Alter
The original. The one page Velok never managed to alter. I washed my hands before reading. Please read it with me. This was written by someone who was in the room that day. Arden was outside the door, and the King of Frost shut his eyes in fear, he said. Velok was inside, taking it down. He was the scribe.
Read the unaltered original with Isabel the archivist.
다 읽었어요. 여덟째 왕은 제자가 손을 넣을 걸 알았어요. 그래서 벨로크: I've read it all. The eighth king knew his apprentice would put his hand in. So he asked Velok. To hold a mirror. To catch the name as it burned. Not all of it could be saved, but some letters might remain. 'When that child is able to let me go, give them back to him then.' Velok waited a thousand years for that 'when'. For the child to become able to let go. And he knew the hatred he had handed him was keeping that day from coming. …Five letters are in the altar. The sixth is on the Elder's hand. Only the seventh and eighth remain. I think I know where they are.
일곱째 글자는 점이에요. 어머니가 찾은 곳마다 찍던 잉크 점요. 어머니는: The seventh letter is a dot. The ink dot my mother left wherever she found something. She saw that shape on one unaltered page. She used it as a mark without knowing what it meant. It was a letter. The eighth is a sound. Some letters are written only as sound, it seems. The cry the dragon of the void gave as it fell. That dragon kept the eighth king's dirge. For a thousand years it held the last sound of its master's name in its throat. The echo shard took it down. At the end of Chapter 1. Bring me one shard. I'll fit them together at the altar.
메아리 조각 1개를 기록관 이사벨에게 가져가고, 룬 제단 앞에서 여덟 글: Bring 1 echo shard to Isabel the archivist, and fit the eight letters together at the Rune Altar.
(이사벨이 한 줄을 적는다. 재의 잉크로. 천천히. 또박또박.) 다섯 돌: (Isabel writes one line. In the ink of ash. Slowly. Each stroke clear.) Five stones. The stroke on a hand. An ink dot. And a dragon's cry. Joined, they make a sound. 'Orel.' In the old tongue it means dawn. King of the Isle of Dawn. Through hundreds of pulls at the altar you were touching five letters of this name. I'd been looking at the seventh since the first day of Chapter 1. The Elder held the sixth in his hand for a thousand years. Each of us carrying a piece, and none of us able to read it. I've filled the empty line. One thing is left. Whether to let the Elder hear this name.
(수도회 지하. 문은 열려 있다. 노인이 벽을 보고 앉아 있다.) 자네군: (The Order's cellar. The door is open. An old man sits facing the wall.) It's you. I know the step. And Isabel. Carrying a sheet of paper. …I won't ask what that paper is. If I ask, I shall ask for it. He asked to be let go. I have chosen to let go. Only days ago. My hand still feels empty. You decide. I have no right to.
Decide whether to let Erwin hear his teacher's name.
(이사벨이 연대기를 덮는다.) 적었어요. 이것도요. 조사대원님이 정한 대: (Isabel closes the Chronicle.) I wrote it. This too. As you decided. I wrote Velok's name as well. 'The senior who wrote a kind lie. For a thousand years he repeated his teacher's name, one letter a day.' The mirrors are all broken but the Rune Altar stands. The five stones look like letters now. I'll still call them by those silly names. Attack, defence, evasion. The teacher would have laughed, he said. So let him laugh.
조사대원님, 장부를 정리하다 이상한 것을 찾았습니다. 폭풍 조사대의 배: Surveyor, I found something odd while tidying the ledgers. The Storm Survey Corps' ships. Seventeen have come from across the sea so far. Would you look at the arrival records side by side.
Go through the arrival ledger with Haru the town clerk.
정리하겠습니다. 열일곱 척 전부 폭풍 속에 입항했습니다. 한 척도 예외가: Let me sum up. All seventeen came in under a storm. Not one exception. Yet no ship was wrecked. Not a sail torn. The crews say the same thing: 'the storm circled the ship once and passed.' …The Order gave the 'Storm Survey Corps' its name. I took it to mean you survey storms. Perhaps it meant the ships a storm surveys. Ledgers cannot lie.
조사대원님 앞으로 꾸러미가 왔어요. 동쪽 망루 쪽에서 화살에 묶여 날아왔: A bundle came for you. Tied to an arrow, from the direction of the eastern tower. One line in charcoal on the outside: 'The debtor remembers.' It's Kas. The captain you let go. Let's open it together. …Honestly, I'm a little afraid.
Open the bundle Kas sent together with Isabel the archivist.
깃발 조각이었어요. 노래의 둘째 절이 수놓인. 그리고 그 사이에 깨진 인: A scrap of banner. With the second verse of the song stitched on it. And between the folds a broken piece of a seal. Handed down in Kas's family, he says. 'What an ancestor who stepped off a ship was holding.' So not all of the Ashen Band descend from those left on land. Some stepped off ships. Which ships?
벽에 남은 둘째 절: The Second Verse on the Wall
조사대원님, 수도회 지하에 같이 가 주세요. 카스의 방이요. 밥을 가져갔: Surveyor, come down under the Order with me. To Kas's cell. I brought his meal and it was empty. Still locked. I asked the Elder and he said only 'I let him go.' He wouldn't say why. There's something scratched on the wall. I'm afraid to read it alone.
In the empty cell under the Order, examine what is left on the wall.
노래의 둘째 절이었어요. 손톱으로 긁은. 그리고 침상 밑에 이 인장 조각: It was the second verse of the song. Scratched with fingernails. And this piece of a seal under the cot. Left on purpose. The lowest line on the wall is for us. 'Your Elder listened to this song at the door every night. He wept at the second verse. Ask him why.' …I can't ask. Not yet.
서기 양반이 폭풍 얘기를 묻더군. 조사대 배마다 따라붙는 그 폭풍 말이오: The clerk asked me about storms. The one that follows every Corps ship. I've cast nets in that sea all my life. Once, just once, I went into the middle of it. When I was young. I'll tell you. In return bring me a nautilus shell. They only came up in the net the day after that storm passed. Haven't caught one in years. The storm's been pinned in the north.
Bring 1 nautilus shell to Oscar the fisherman and hear his story.
그래, 이거요. 귀에 대 보시오. 파도 소리가 아니지. 가락이오. 그 폭: Yes, this. Hold it to your ear. That's not waves. It's a tune. The tune I heard inside that storm. …I heard it the year the sea froze, too. The night before. Very near. From where Captain Cornelia's ship had gone. I never told anyone. I didn't know whether the storm followed the ship or the ship sailed into the storm.
다섯 개를 다 모으셨군요. 은화, 비늘, 악보, 일지 조각, 인장. 책상: You have all five. The coin, the scale, the song, the log scrap, the seal. I laid them out on the desk and looked at them for three days. They aren't separate things. They all belonged to one person. They fell out of one logbook. Let me piece them together. Stay with me. I don't think I'll want to be alone when I've read it.
Watch Isabel the archivist fit the five clues together.
여덟째 왕에게는 쌍둥이 누이가 있었어요. 새벽의 섬의 제독. 왕을 회의에: The eighth king had a twin sister. Admiral of the Isle of Dawn. She carried the king to the council by ship and promised to come out and welcome him when he returned. The day his name burned she was at sea, and she wrapped her fleet in a storm. Because the world cannot see inside the eye of a storm. So she was not forgotten. But she forgot whom she had come to meet. For a thousand years she has looked into every passing ship. Ours too. …Surveyor, she is no monster. She is keeping a promise.
기록관 아가씨한테 들었소. 그 폭풍 안에 사람들이 천 년째 있다고. 내가: The archivist girl told me. That there have been people inside that storm for a thousand years. The ones I saw on that deck. …Let's find a wreck. Now and then a ship gets pushed out of the storm. Once it's outside the eye it eats a thousand years in a day. Rots and sinks. What's left aboard will tell us how they live in there. I'm coming. I know a little about waiting at sea.
Find a shipwreck with Oscar and examine what is left in the cabin.
밧줄이 전부 사려져 있었소. 던질 수 있게. 천 년 동안 매일 다시 사렸: Every rope was coiled. Ready to throw. Re-coiled every day for a thousand years. And that roster. The column for the day each sailor disembarked, empty all the way down. Not one went ashore. Nobody leaves until the admiral has finished her welcome. …Just like Captain Cornelia. Nobody dies on my ship. Nobody leaves this one. Captains.
폭풍의 눈 속으로: Into the Eye of the Storm
…앉게. 이사벨이 내게 왔었네. 다섯 조각을 들고. 아무 말도 안 하고: …Sit. Isabel came to me. With the five pieces. Laid them on my desk without a word. She did not ask. So I will tell. I know her. My master's… no. The old king's sister. You hold the storm eye? Then the storm will let you in. Go to the palace on the sea. And see there, for yourself, what I did.
Carrying the storm eye, find the palace on the sea and examine the empty banquet hall.
보았군. 차려 둔 상을. …그래. 내가 보냈네. 코넬리아의 배를. 그분이: So you saw the table she keeps laid. …Yes. I sent it. Cornelia's ship. I wanted to hear whether, when she looked into a ship, she would speak the name of the one she sought. I told the captain to write it down. She did not speak a name. She does not know it. And in the middle of the storm a frightened sailor dropped anchor, and the anchor struck the seal. The sea froze. I burned a ship to hear one name. I have no excuse. Go and put her to rest. I cannot. She knows my face. She would ask me: 'Where is the boy?'
가는 거요? 그럼 이걸 들고 가시오. 내 등불이오. 아들이 돌아온 날 끈: You're going? Then take this. My lamp. The one I put out the day my son came home. You don't tell someone who waits 'that's enough' with a sword. Still, there's no getting through that storm without one. She isn't bound to a seal but to a promise, the archivist says, so she can't be brought into a gate. You face her in the heart of the storm. The lightning has eight forks. Mind the eighth. That one she throws herself.
바다 위의 궁에서 폭풍의 여제 스킬라를 잠재우세요. (최대 체력의 10%: In the palace on the sea, put Scylla the Storm Empress to rest. (Deal at least 10% of her health.)
The storm lifted. I saw it all from the dock. Stars in the northern sky for the first time in a thousand years. And the ships came in. Ships with lightning on their sails. People stepped ashore. One by one. Each touched ground and looked back. For the admiral. …Go to the archivist. She's standing on the dock with the roster. Says she'll fill in the 'day disembarked'.
You were on the dock. I was taking down the sailors' names. More than three hundred. Every one wrote today's date under 'day disembarked'. But the top line is left. The admiral's. She asked you at the end, they say. Where that person is. You know, don't you. Where the eighth king is. And that he chose it. What did you tell her?
Tell Isabel the archivist what you answered the Storm Empress.
적을게요. 맨 윗줄에. 「마중하는 이」. 새벽의 섬의 제독. 누구를 맞으: I'll write it. On the top line. 'She Who Welcomes'. Admiral of the Isle of Dawn. Who laid a table for a thousand years after forgetting whom she had come to meet. Day disembarked… I'll leave it blank. She did not disembark. She went to meet him. Truly, this time. (Isabel closes the roster.) Surveyor. In the prologue they said our ship broke through a storm. It didn't. She looked at each face, and let us pass.
